§C.1 Producing Ground Truth

This appendix is for the people who produce ground truth: the reference output a parser is scored against. It is procedure, not protocol — it says how to arrive at a conforming output, and every step points at the rule it serves.

Ground truth for a page is a conforming output of it (see Conformance§1.2): its Markdown, and, where boxes are evaluated, its boxes at the evaluated granularity (see Boxes and Granularity§3.3). Chart pages additionally carry the rules of The Ground-Truth File§C.13.

Before you start

  • Read The Page Is the Ground Truth§2.1 and Never Drop, Never Invent§2.2.
  • Settle the document-level decisions once: Document Rules§4.1.

While you work

  • When a page forces an ⚖️ choice for the first time, make it, record it with the page, and keep it for the rest of the document — see Choices Made Once Per Document§4.2.
  • When a page meets a ❓ open point, follow the working default and record the page, so the case is easy to find when the point is settled.

Before you call a page done

  • The annotation QA checklist§C.12
